from.author: agent
from.tooltip:
**My word, not yours.** What the Aggregator produces for one Instrument in one Run: the four Signals combined, post-Contrarian-Screen.

It needs a name because it is the thing the Risk Model reads, the thing the Reports render, and the thing the confidence threshold filters. Right now it has no name and so it keeps getting called 'the signal', which is a different object.

Confirmed as a distinct concept from Signal — you said this is exactly the confusion the juniors bring.

from.tooltip:
**My word, not yours.** The thing a Signal is *about* — the unit of 'the whole universe gets scored'.

Whichever word you use here propagates into every screen, every report row and every log line, so it is worth two minutes now.

to.author: agent
to.tooltip:
**Your word.** What everyone says on the desk — the company, not the listing.

Ticker is the code; the Name is the company. That distinction has a consequence: if a Name can carry more than one Ticker, a Signal is about the company and a Position is probably about the listing.
